test_title: PYST 30: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Her __judicious__ act made him popular overnight.
solution: The correct answer is: **Unwise**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word '**judicious**' means having or showing good judgment. (अच्छा निर्णय लेना या दिखाना) • **Example**: *He made a judicious decision after carefully weighing the pros and cons.* • The antonym of 'judicious' is '**unwise**', which means lacking good judgement or sense. (अच्छे निर्णय या समझ का अभाव) • **Example**: *Ignoring the warnings proved to be unwise, leading to unforeseen consequences.* • In the given sentence, the protagonist's judicious act made him popular overnight. • Therefore, the opposite of judicious would be an act that lacks good judgment or sense, making **Option 2** the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Criminal**: Engaged in illegal activities or behaviour. (अवैध गतिविधियों या व्यवहार में लिप्त होना) • **Loyal**: Faithful and committed in allegiance or support. (निष्ठा या समर्थन में वफादार और प्रतिबद्ध) • **Lawful**: In accordance with the law or rules; legal. (कानून या नियमों के अनुसार) 3a:T95f, The correct answer is: **Petulant**.
